newsitem.title: USA: ABC/Money consumer comfort index at record high.
newsitem.headline: ABC/Money consumer comfort index at record high.

text.p: The Money Magazine/ABC News index of consumer comfort rose five points, all time high of nine, in the week ended June 15 from the prior week.
The index has skyrocketed 12 points in the last five weeks, and surpassed the previous record high of eight set in polling through May 11, 1986, Money said.
The survey, polls consumers nationwide about the national economy, personal finances and their willingness to spend.

Respondents' confidence in the economy strengthened to boost the economic index to 12 from eight. Confidence in personal finances rose to 26 from 20, while the rating of buying climate creeped higher to -12 from -16.

Regionally, confidence remained highest in the Midwest at 18, but attitudes surged most in the South, whose index was up nine points to eight. Gains were also registered in the West and Northeast, Money said.
The current poll has a margin error of plus or minus 3.5 percentage points.
